source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of alcohols and their classes (PDF 89-90).

blocks.text: Hydroxyl group (-OH) tamam alcohols ka functional group hai, jin ka aam formula ROH hai, jahan R alkyl group hai. Is khandan mein cholesterol aur carbohydrates jaise maanoos maadde bhi shamil hain. Methanol (CH3OH) aur ethanol (CH3CH2OH) monohydric alcohols ki homologous series ke pehle do arkaan hain.

items: -OH groups ki tadaad se: monohydric alcohols mein aik (ethanol, propan-1-ol); polyhydric alcohols mein aik se zyada, maslan ethane-1,2-diol (glycol, do) aur propane-1,2,3-triol (glycerol, teen).

blocks.alt: Chaar alcohols: ethanol CH3CH2OH aur propan-1-ol CH3CH2CH2OH; 1,2-ethanediol (glycol), do CH2-OH ikaiyan oopar neeche; aur 1,2,3-propanetriol (glycerol), CH2-OH, CH-OH aur CH2-OH oopar neeche.
blocks.caption: Monohydric aur polyhydric alcohols: ethanol, propan-1-ol, glycol aur glycerol (kitab ke PDF safha 89 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ethanol aur propan-1-ol mein sirf aik -OH hai (monohydric). Glycol mein do aur glycerol mein teen -OH hain, har carbon par aik (polyhydric). Kitab ne naam '1,2-ethandiol' aur '1,2,3-propantriol' chhape hain; poore hijje 1,2-ethanediol (ethane-1,2-diol) aur 1,2,3-propanetriol (propane-1,2,3-triol) hain.

items: -OH wale carbon se: primary (1) alcohol, RCH2OH, mein yeh aik doosre carbon se jura (methanol mein kisi se nahi); secondary (2) alcohol, R2CHOH, mein do se; tertiary (3) alcohol, R3COH, mein teen se.

blocks.alt: Teen aam khuli banawatein, har aik mein carbon ke baen R1 aur daen OH: primary alcohol (oopar neeche H), secondary alcohol (oopar R2, neeche H) aur tertiary alcohol (oopar R2, neeche R3).
blocks.caption: Primary, secondary aur tertiary alcohols ki aam banawat (kitab ke PDF safha 90 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: -OH wale carbon ko dekhein: us se kitne doosre carbon (R groups) jure hain? Aik R (R1) ho to primary, do (R1, R2) to secondary, teen (R1, R2, R3) to tertiary. Baqi jagahon par H hain.

blocks.alt: Chhe skeletal alcohols, a se f: a) chaar carbon ki zanjeer, methyl shaakh, OH zanjeer ke sire par; b) aik carbon jis par do methyl, aik ethyl aur OH; c) chaar carbon ki zanjeer ke doosre carbon par OH; d) paanch carbon ki zanjeer ke sire par OH; e) chaar carbon ki zanjeer ke doosre carbon par OH aur teesre par methyl; f) paanch kone wala ring (ring) OH ke saath.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 22.1: primary, secondary ya tertiary batane ke liye alcohols (kitab ke PDF safha 90 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Quick Check 22.1 mein bane chhe alcohols ko primary, secondary ya tertiary batayein.
blocks.explanation: Khaakon se parh kar: (a) 3-methylbutan-1-ol, primary; (b) 2-methylbutan-2-ol, tertiary; (c) butan-2-ol, secondary; (d) seedhi zanjeer wala alkan-1-ol, primary; (e) 3-methylbutan-2-ol, secondary; (f) cyclopentanol, secondary.

items: Primary RCH2OH, secondary R2CHOH, tertiary R3COH.
